newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Nine killed when Argentine truck plunges off road.
newsitem.headline: Nine killed when Argentine truck plunges off road.

text.p: Nine farm workers were killed and 11 injured when the truck in which they were being driven to work plunged off a mountain road in the northwestern Argentine province of Catamarca early on Monday.
The road was slippery because of recent heavy rains, local media quoted police as saying. They said they thought the driver might have fallen asleep at the wheel.
